name: OpenVibe Connect

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP, with how many computers are connected; the database, Network's JWKS and the OAuth client are what /api/ready checks

drains: HTTP server closed and in-flight requests drained
every tunnel closed with 1001 (the computers reconnect to the next process by themselves)
the request counters written, the one-time codes dropped
JWKS refresher stopped, telemetry flushed, PostgreSQL pool closed, then the Events subscriptions stopped

resumes.what: connected computers reconnect with backoff (1 s to 30 s) and say hello again; nothing about a tunnel is kept across a restart
the account export and deletion subscriptions at OpenVibe.Events are renewed at boot; a delivery missed while stopped is redelivered and applied once (account_data_events keeps it idempotent)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migration 0001 only creates Connect's own tables (shares, share_visits) plus the SDK's; an earlier release reads none of them

leases.none: one process holds every tunnel; a second process would need the share-to-tunnel routing CON-3 adds

notes: Port 5240, unit openvibe-connect.service, PostgreSQL database ov_connect. Website Connect v0 (plan 2026-10-28 §5.9b; ADR-057 as reviewed 2026-11-02): a share is one port on a person's computer at https://<label>--<user>.openvibe.link behind OpenVibe sign-in (on OpenVibe Link since 2026-11-08; connect.openvibe.website and its old share hosts answer page loads with a 302 to the same path on openvibe.link), carried by a one-file client (Node 22) over one WebSocket on 443 (ovconnect-ws/1). Space site names never contain "--", so share hosts and Space sites never collide; nginx sends *--*.openvibe.link (and the legacy *--*.openvibe.website) here and every other *.openvibe.website to Space. Modes owner, named and signin (staff-first); no public shares until CON-9 and CON-21. The share API is a person's (session or Network user token): GET/POST /api/v1/shares, GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/shares/:id, POST /api/v1/shares/:id/key, GET /api/v1/shares/:id/visits. The website.*/connect.*/events.hook* capabilities stay planned until the QUIC edge, the Link plugin and the hooks land (CON-3/4/5/15). OAuth client `connect`; answers account export and deletion (ADR-033) and subscribes to those Events topics.

site.name: Connect
site.tagline: Your computer, on the web, privately
site.what: Share one port on your computer at its own HTTPS address on openvibe.link. Only the people you pick can open it, signed in with OpenVibe. One file and Link: no router settings, no open ports.
